comparison_notes.2024_general: different: verifier could not read any Freestone result file in its blind pass (all links tried returned 404) and recorded UNDETERMINED; research read 2024/unofficial_official_results_1152024.pdf. Verifier opened the cited file afterwards: Summary Results Report, UNOFFICIAL RESULTS, county totals, footer "Election Summary - 11/05/2024 10:18 PM", Last-Modified 06 Nov 2024 19:00 GMT (next day). The research LATER is supported (printed on election night); with it the research tag COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS low follows the fixed rule. The disagreement comes from the verifier missing this file, not from a research error.
